function.name: get_apple_calendar_events
function.description: Fetch upcoming events from the user's Apple Calendar (iCloud). Use this when the user asks about their schedule or upcoming events.

days_ahead.description: Number of days ahead to look for events. Default is 7.

function.name: add_apple_calendar_event
function.description: Create a new event on the user's Apple Calendar. Use this when the user asks to schedule something, add an event, or block time.

title.description: The name or title of the event.

start_time.description: Start time in ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2026-08-15T14:30:00'.

end_time.description: End time in ISO 8601 format, e.g., '2026-08-15T15:30:00'.

description.description: Optional notes or description for the event.

category_definitions.schoolwork: Assignments, exams, homework, classes, studying, and academic projects.
category_definitions.homestuff: Chores, home repairs, family tasks, cleaning, and house errands.
category_definitions.events: Social outings, parties, hangouts with friends, concerts, and leisure activities.
category_definitions.personal: Doctor or dental appointments, self-care, personal reminders, and health.
